_comment: Average cold rent (Kaltmiete) per m²/month, used to estimate gross rental yield for the minRoiPercent job filter. These are rough starting estimates, not sourced live - check current numbers (e.g. immoscout24 Mietspiegel, empirica, or your local Gutachterausschuss) before relying on them, and edit this file freely; Fredy reloads it automatically on change.
